name: Stump

spine.record: an item for a venue, published from an account or handed to a member, and its ledger entry read back from the network

description: Earned-channels marketing desk: find where your customers gather, show up in your own voice, and see what it brings in.
nonGoals: Personas, composite identities or account pools: Stump speaks only as real people and the company
Software-started likes, reposts, comments or votes, keyword-triggered replies, reviews written for others, or bought engagement
Scraping or automating a network's signed-in site
Hosted operation on a fresh account remains unverified

deploy.notes: Native owner sessions guard /app; unknown paths return real 404s; development and demo mail is suppressed.
